description: This file defines a data class 'Block' representing code blocks (functions or classes) in Python source code, including properties and methods for analyzing code structure, decorators, and hierarchy.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a code block (class or function) in Python source code, with properties for hierarchy, decorators, and code analysis.

methods.name: as_data
methods.description: Returns the block's data as a dictionary, suitable for serialization.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if this block contains another block based on line numbers.

methods.name: display_name
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly name for the block, including its type and full name.

methods.name: decorators
methods.description: Retrieves the list of decorators applied to the function or method.

methods.name: is_override
methods.description: Determines if the method overrides a parent method based on decorators.

methods.name: is_init
methods.description: Checks if the block is an __init__ method.
